entities.summary: Sir Geoffrey Nice KC is a British barrister and former part-time judge. In the 1983 United Kingdom general election and the 1987 United Kingdom general election, he was the unsuccessful Social Democratic Party candidate for Dover. He took part in the International Criminal Tribunal for the Former Yugoslavia and was lead prosecutor at Slobodan Milošević's 2002 trial.
